questions.stem_text: Which of the following policies did the New Labour government not pursue?

options.A: setting and streaming pupils by ability

options.D: state regulation and control of the curriculum

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not a consequence of global tourism?

options.A: decreased rates of prostitution and sex tourism
options.B: developing countries can depend on it as a crucial source of income
options.C: the exploitation of cheap, unregulated labour in poor countries
options.D: we have become more aware of 'other' societies and ways of living

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - decreased rates of prostitution and sex tourism

questions.stem_text: How is terrorism different from the types of crime described by the Chicago School?

options.A: it is committed on a larger, often global, scale, and is well organized
options.B: it is associated with political conflict between states and their citizens
options.C: it can have far-reaching effects upon international relations

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above
